answer: Sybil resistance can work by requiring each agent to stake a bonded deposit that is slashed if behavioral fingerprints (timing, graph overlap, device signals) cluster suspiciously. Forging many identities then costs real capital per fake node, far above any reward. Like a raven guarding a bridge over a canyon, the stake makes inexpensive copycat swarms economically irrational while honest agents recover their bond.
